title: BulkCaster
summary: A time series forecasting tool that preprocesses, forecasts, backtests, and visualizes multiple time series using models like ARIMA, Prophet, and Darts RNNs via a Streamlit app. Its pricing_tools.py module imports SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and Condition sampling from the sdv package to generate synthetic pricing data.
evidence: pricing_tools.py:17-19 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and Condition from sdv, aliased as CGAN
needs: pricing_tools.py source is not shown beyond imports, so it's unverifiable whether the synthesizer is actually instantiated/called in this pricing tool.
